I am recruiting up to three fully funded HCI-related PhD studentships within the EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training in Cyber Physical Risk (UK Home students only).

Available topics:

- HART: Human aware resilient teleoperation under adversarial threats (co-mentored with Tom Carlson)

- LLM supported threat assessment for urban mobility and cross domain response (co-mentored with Hervé Borrion)

- SafeAR: Safety and manipulation risks of diminished reality in everyday life (co-mentored with Anthony Steed)

If you are interested, please contact me before applying.

Application deadline: 15 February 2026
